description: Who is out at one club right now, and its next National League game (next_game): each player with type, reason as the source published it, since when, the expected return, confidence and sources. By default only players counted as out; ask for categories to include healthy scratches or loans.

categories.description: Which entries: "out" (default: injured, ill, suspended and other absences), "scratch" (fit, left out by the coach), "loan" (farm team or another club), or "all".

team.description: The club: its slug from list_teams (e.g. "zug", "rapperswil", "lugano") or its name ("EV Zug", "SCRJ Lakers").

name: get_team_absences
title: A club's unavailable players
